t:
Technomagic... My people created it, and now everyone's using it. It's wonderful.

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Have you ever flown a ship? Driven a Lightning Bolt? Used Mana Batteries?

Perhaps you have broken into Nihaz's Citadel? Or taken down architects? Excellent.

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it.
h: Get a degree in magic engineering

t: Technomagic pushes us forward, bringing us closer to a new world with every step.
Well... Shall we start with the ritual?

At last someone's bothered to create the Divine Observatory! Right now, we only need to fill it with the information that we, the Historians, have collected! It was our studies of the legacy of Junes, after all, that allowed us to learn where Tep has found that shard of Darkness! Now, when the legends of Junes have been collected and systemized, we know with certainty how Sarn, Nihaz and all of the other Gods were involved in this story! Yes, even those worshipped by these insane cultists!

Listen, citizens! If you dream of justice and defending the order, I have a perfect offer for you! Muneph costumes are not just things to wear, they're your chance to become heroes! Put on our costume and feel the power of the law!
Overlord Tep promised us eternal life, the Gift of the Free Spark! And it happened! Now everyone is free!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: No, I can't do that yet...
Love is like witchcraft: not always clear, but always pleasant!
Then it is not my purview – go to window 3!

h: I'd like to get an appointment with the head of the city department!

quests: Xadaganian artifacts: Kiss of Mother Djut

t: Each rocket is not just a device – it's a dream assembled of metal and oil. Today, we are sending a part of our heart into the sky!

quests: Quotidien au bureau : Rapports de test du Portail

t: The City Council has always been naive. They were looking for a conspiracy in the ranks of Zem... But what if the Zem people themselves are the conspiracy? What if loyalists and traitors are only part of the overall plan? Such a thoughtful game, such a grand plan that everyone who participates in it, willingly or unwillingly, are working to bring about his victory? There are no absolutists, no mystics, and no progressors - only those who have patience and those who do not. Tep and Ur, we're tired of waiting!
If the body is weak and the spirit is strong, can the body be changed to match the spirit? Many of us have gone much further than others have dared.

quests: Quotidien au bureau : Rapports de test du Portail

r182891.s: Junior Employee of the Dome Laboratory

h: What new data have you obtained?

t: Have a nice day, colleague! I'm busy studying the operation of prosthetics, and their interaction with the brain's bionic signals!

Our program was significantly slashed!

It's all the same every day: microscopes, samples, records. I'm even starting to thin that my life is now an endless cycle of monotony. Where are the exciting experiments we've dreamt of? Every time I see a new project, I'm hoping it turns out to be something exciting. But instead, they give me a task for analyzing data, again and again. Don't we have any creative tasks left to do?

Here's the new data for you...
h: What new information has become available over this past week?

quests: Problèmes de construction : Chefs du culte de Tep

t: I am Taras Skotinin, not the last of my kind. The Skotinin family is great and ancient. Not every fault is the same. Isn't a nobleman free to beat a servant whenever he wants...?

Wow, I’m glad to see that someone is interested in our science!

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Metaphysics, huh. Well, you already know our world well. Of course, there are things you still don't understand, but at least you have mastered the basics.

Gods, astral... You'll learn more with time.

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it.
Metaphysics is a useful science in this world where our views are shaped by events large and small.

What do you need this degree for?

But oh well. What do we have here? Ah, technomagic, magic engineering, and other clever-sounding nonsense.

Fine, fine. Well, how is it going? Have you ever flown a ship? And ridden a Lightning Bolt? Do you use Mana Batteries?

Have you ever broke into Nihaz's Citadel? Or taken down architects?

I can see you know what I'm talking about. Here, kid! You have your documents now!
h: Get a degree in magic engineering

t: Hey, cap. I'm going to teach arts and crafts to the stonefaces.
I told you, I'm a professor. Why? Amos invited me. The pay isn't bad here. You almost say that like it's something amazing.
h: Nogrom? What are you doing here?

t:
Your actions may help Horizon in the distant future... believe it or not. Just as their adventures in the last allod can be beneficial to you.

You probably have extra Expansion Tokens and Crystal Chips. I can sell you a rod that can turn them into Horizon Stones. You can send these stones to Horizon. I can also exchange your Coins of the Dark Times for Horizon Stones.

In Horizon, you can get a chest with powerful items of the Draconic Aspect and various boxes with useful items. You can send them to Allods Online and get the rewards inside.
h: Learn more about the transfer to Horizon

t:
We both know what common people can’t be allowed to know.

What do you want? To help your descendant or to receive their offering?

I can’t help you right now.

Item transfer is not available at this time.

Come back later.
It's been a while since we had such a terrible thunderstorm! My grandfather once said... oh, never mind...

h: We can't find Katerina! Perhaps you've seen her?

t: I have a strange job these days... Sometimes I bury someone, and then in a week or two he's up and walking again... It's not right!
The Light sends me visions... Our world needs to be cleansed of Darkness! This cleansing will happen through fire... all who are weak in spirit will burn in it... Only the most steadfast will remain.
What do I do now, spend the rest of my days as a ghost?

Oh, my! There are creatures I've never seen in our forest! The Pridens are inviting me to Howlem - to see their forests... I think I'll go...

Well, once we drink all the beer here!
Some kind of ancient evil is radiating from beyond these new walls...

Leave us, you proud, disdainful man!

We are savage, and we do not have laws,

But we do not torture, and we do not kill.

We have no need of blood or groans,

But to live with a murderer we have no wish.

A demon! What do you want? Leave me alone!
You scum! I'll find you even in the world beyond and wring your neck! Oh, sorry, I wasn't talking to you. Ignatius Chernov is a real bastard! There was a fight in the ruins and he hit me. He said, "Sorry, I swung at the skeleton and you got in the way." That blind freak! It's a flesh wound, too. Nothing to look at! So why does it burn so bad? I feel like my insides are crawling out. Ignatius, you bastard... I'll get you even in the world beyond!

quests: The Plague of the Wandering Island

t: I saw a trail in the east that leads to the old ruins. I’d swear there was an underground tunnel, and the ruins looked a lot like a June temple.
Oh, how interesting! And why not? I'll go. Perhaps I'll find my admirer there...
h: You have been invited to the casino. Will you come?

t: Oh, Dar Ulgorn is a nice place for a walk... The city is quite impressive!
What am I to do if I love him and the other one, too?

Greetings!

We are building this fortress for the glory of the Empire and our illustrious leader Yasker. Every day gives us a new challenge, and we face it like the valiant citizen of the Empire we are.

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

You see a field of roses, and there's a Tower beyond it. Is that Sogot?

The visions change too quickly, you cannot make out anything. The images form a strange picture of a Dragon in your mind. But it is not a Dragon at all. A creature of nightmares that seems to be made of darkness pierced by crests of flame. Its power, its magic, its rage.

Ollum cuts off the stream of images. Is he dreaming it? Do astral demons have nightmares?

Ollum sends you another stream of images. Joy, peace, happiness. Then you see yourself from the outside. The demon seems happy here and now.

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

You see endless sands and mountains shaped by time.

The visions change too quickly, you cannot make out anything. You see the outline of the Gates that lead somewhere beyond Sarnaut. You sense the demon's desire. He wants to go there... a Star Trail leading to another world? For a moment, you realize that Ollum is showing you the memories of your Creator, Sarn. The only moment of clarity - the place where it all began - is all you can grasp.

Ollum cuts off the stream of images. It seems to be all he wanted you to see.

And now the demon wants to wish you a happy Anniversary.

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

Again you see the familiar sands of Suslanger, the mountains, and the Gates behind them.

You feel the impatience of the demons who can't wait to travel to outer space. But the demons need to wait – they are discouraged from urgent and hasty actions. You sense a conflict between the packs. Some of them are more impatient than others. The rage of these packs is growing.

Ollum cuts off the stream of images. It seems to be all he wanted you to see.

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

The visions change too quickly, you cannot make out anything.
...The demon is carelessly hovering and doesn’t seem to notice you.
... The Demon doesn’t seem talkative but his greeting emotion feels pretty friendly.

In response to your question, Ollum “ejects” another mental stream of pictures.

Demons are alarmed. During Sarn’s rule, they already encountered Nihaz, and he proved to be a formidable enemy. But it appears that demons have no intention of abandoning their plans. The ship that’s meant to leave Sarnaut will still be built. Ollum understands your concern, but there’s nothing he can do.
h: Ollum, what can you tell me about the prophecy?

t: You can bind your Adventurer's Stone to Ollum's Demonic Portal in order to be able to return here at any moment.

A familiar feeling overwhelms you as you approach the demon. It seems to be trying to say something, but with fragments of images and thoughts.

One of the distinct messages inside your head says: "No war. We come in peace".

The demon seems to be anxious - now your head fills with peculiar images. His message, however, becomes clear and consistent.

You see that the invisible bonds that were connecting every demon to Sarn were gone when he died. Demons learned a new word - liberty... But not all of them understood it. Ollum - that's the name of the demon who is trying to speak to you - is a chieftain of a small pack.

You suddenly realize what the demon wants - he offers Aoidoi his pack in exchange for the access... to the power of the Well?

If the demon had hesitated, you didn't notice that. You heard his consent in your head even before you finished speaking.

Now you just need to give blood to other demons.

h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
...The demon seems to hesitate. You can sense several “pallidly colored” waves of his emotions before Ollum finally answers.

‘A slaughter,’ thinks Ollum. ‘Demons will fight until the end. But they cannot outlive the god of Darkness.

There is no hatred or fear in his thoughts. Something more like... disappointment?
h: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

t: ...The demon is carelessly hovering and doesn’t seem to notice you.
I'm not some savage. My father is the chieftain of the tribe that lives in the mountains! We were here while Junes still walked this land...
Did Pechorin send you? Have you broughtbrought it?

I see you havehave it with you! Wow, what a rhino. There is no other like it in the world! Brick must be livid. But who cares, let him keep looking - tomorrow I'll be on the other side of the allod... And I brought my sister as agreed... She's already in the Fortecia.

Ohoho. Rysina, you say...

I feel uneasy. You know my story, right? I was a simple orc, dreamed of becoming the best goblinball player. But then Council snatched me up. Put me here and started experimenting on me. That’s how you and I met. Ugh, I dread to imagine what would’ve happened if things had gone differently.

And Rysina was the one who sanctioned it...
h: What do you think about the meeting?

t:
It's easier to ask how many stars are in the sky or how many grains of sand are in this desert! Once upon a time, each clan had its own shaman and obeyed him... A military leader was elected only when the need arose...

Now... There are many who don't listen to spirits yet want to lead the tribe. At least there's a lot of us...

We have the Nimble, the Northwind, the Free, the Wild, the Smokedry, the Riverborn, the Montane, the Crafty, the Maritime, the Sandy, the Merciless, the Gloomy, the Nomadic, the Salty, the Sleepy, the Fierce, the Brainy, and the Clever on our side! Is that not enough? And that's only the ones I remembered.
h: Which clans report to the shamans?

t: Wind, rain, soil - everything obeys the shamans!

Hah! The shamans started this uprising, heh.

We have been looking for the descendants of the Legendary Orc for centuries. We believed that sooner or later he would be found.

The Orcs should be free! So says Kurgan, so says Wrokag. And all the shamans agree with it. Now our task is to help Skulnar with everything. Skulnar will leads to freedom. And then the Orcs will realize that it was achieved thanks to the shamans.
h: What do the shamans think about the rebellion?

t: I don't believe you, but I believe the prophecy.

Oh, wow. Let me think.

Of course, I don't like it. Machines, technology... It's all nonsense. The strength of the Orcs lies elsewhere, even though we can utilize whatever Xadagan produces.

So this Felix wants to take the power of the Ambrosia for himself?

That's not going to happen!
h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
What do we do...

Are these Children warriors? Perhaps shamans? Hmm, you say they're doing alright...

Well, try to organize resistance. The Empire has brought a horde of machines there, but these natives can still put up a fight.
It's my shaman business. Keep out of it. The things I had to do for this... But never mind. At least it's not too hot here.
h: Where did you get this aura?

t: Whaaat? There's another arm?! That's weird, no one's warned me about that... But I think I saw a suspicious hoodlum nearby: he was walking around with an extra limb, and using it to fight off pursuers! Take a look somewhere that way! A very suspicious individual!
h: Haven't you seen the other arm?

t:
It's a little sad... Why? Well, our world was simple, there were us and our enemies, the Urun. Isa was big for us, but now...

Now she has become small, and our enemies are not the same now. The world is so big! There's so much in it! And there are more worlds beyond its borders! There are more of them than grains of sand on the shore. Who are we then in this infinity?

Ugh, I need to wash this thought down... Pour me another!

Oh, I see! The dead are resurrected! Yes, but it's all nonsense - that's what I'll tell you. I know this - I myself have been a ghost for a year now. I'll be honest with you, having no body is not fun. And where do we put a horde of ghosts? There is a place, they say...

Zakh gathered us here, seeing as the people of Umoir are also here. Why not go sailing... We sailed with this Klavdia once... I have a feeling we'll hit the road again soon!

And as for Tep, we've seen worse! If we have to, we will go again, or rather, crawl on our bellies like in those days!

I think I'll go have a beer. I still can't get used to the fact that we are almost alive now...
Eh, I remember how Zak and I crawled all over Gipat on our bellies.
What do you want, cub? You smell weird...
Speak my word for you? I don't know you, cub. You're not of our blood! May Akkya decide your destiny.
The Big Hunt is waiting for us, brother-in-blood! You are different from us... But I can feel your strength! Lead us!
It's a good day for a hunt!
Haven’t seen much of the Eclipse, eh? It’s full of decks like this where the undead – what are they doing anyway? Sleeping?
h: What is this place? What’s going on here?

t: I was told to keep an eye on things and make sure everything is calm. Honestly, things are too calm here. I've only heard some screams from the reactor, but that’s normal. Still, I can’t leave my post.
h: And what are you doing here?

t:
There has to be a secret.

Something. A secret or a mission.

A deadly one... Or it's an invitation!

A summon to a school of wizardry and witchcraft!
h: No secret. I'm looking for your friend, because his sister asked me to.

t:
You call me strange, but you're equally strange to me!

Your pace is fast, your looks are weird, your questions are strange. But you're right.

It's me. What do you seek? A world mystery?
h: You're the strange Aoidos, the recipient of Centaur the Traveler's note?

t: Listen, stranger. What are you doing in the Aoidoi vault?

Oh, hello.
Is there anything you need to fix? Sew on a button or repair an Astral battleship? I can help with anything.

No, it's not a feat... I just can't stay away from work. I grow tired when I'm loitering!
This is our family trait. My elder brother was born with a pick in his hands. Well, figuratively. If he doesn't shovel a couple tons of ore per day, he suffers from headache.
So when they sent us here to "recover", we were out of our minds!
My brother is lucky, he's already discharged from here. They promise to send me back to the capital soon. I can't wait!

Good day!
Please, don't make rapid movements during our conversation. My treatment after the flight crash is not complete.

Reporting!
Within the scope of the "Outside" program I've accomplished the first flight beyond the atmosphere and astralosphere. Manned spacecraft "North" has reached the target altitude and successfully landed.
I'm sorry, but I can't give away what I've seen up there. It's a top secret! You know, I'm not asking you about the mysterious device that the League Crusader was trying to steal! Although I am very interested.
Are you bored? Please have a seat, let's talk.

What are you talking about? "Mother hero", ha! Why, I gave birth to fourteen children, so what? This runs in our family. Life in the steppes is no fun. We wouldn't have survived otherwise. Only one of five orcs reaches adulthood. Now life is safer, we have enough food and medicines, but our nature remains the same.
Everyone around says I'm a hero, but I'm not. When there is a whole platoon of my sons... then call me a hero!
This bulletin board is full of papers.

quests: The Peculiarities of Life in the Capital

t: A century before the Cataclysm, there was a great invasion of Kania by the Emperor Rabulion of Tlavia, and it would have been fortunate had these same Tlavians conquered us then: a smart nation would have conquered a very stupid one and annexed it. It would have been a different life.
A man working hard doesn't think he'll overtax his strength. Should you think over a cup that you'll end up in the gutter afterwards?

We are going about an important business: we have a concern. A concern that has driven us out of our homes.
We can't eat. Give us your word you will hear us out without laughter and answer honestly, or we will take our concern to another...
Well done! Now you can fly around as much as you want. You won't spend any keys. You won't get any loot at the Isle, either. But you don't charge for helping a friend, eh!
Hey. Are you going out into the Astral? I like that. Kill a monster or two for me, will you? You know that you can help your friends out there, but without getting loot?
Good decision. Enough is enough! Ah well, one cannot sponge off their friends forever. Now you will be spending your keys and receive loot again.
Here. Careful, don’t spill the honey!
Do you have a real friend? Not just a friend, but someone who you can trust your life with? Listen, I will tell you about a rite that will bind you.

What is it, to be best friends with someone? I, for instance, have two best friends: a Xadaganian girl and an Arisen. We've been to every other corner of the Astral, crawled through each and every Isle! We're not blood relatives, but they're closer to me than my whole clan! You can't choose a sibling to your taste, but your best friends are your own choice and there's noone to blame. Clear?

You better take this kind of friendship seriously, just as a marriage, though these are not connected. A husband and wife, or a teacher and pupil, or a master and student may become best friends. Any two close friends of at least level 15 can! You may have two best friends at the most, they are to precious to throw around.

This rite is ancient, but simple. First, you will have to buy a ritual honey Bowl of Friendship from me. The stronger you are, the stronger honey you need, the more expensive it is. Offer it to someone, who you want to be best friends with. If they accept, drip a few drops of your bloods in the bowl, take a gulp, and that's it: you're Best Friends!
h: What does it take to become Best Friends?

t: The ties are strong, but still they can be torn. You won't need any special ritual, just say the words: "You're not my Best Friend any more!" If your best friend betrays you and goes over to the League, you won't need any words at all: your friendship is over, you're enemies. Ew, I hate the sound of it!
h: How to stop being Best Friends?

t: There are a lot! Firstly, best friends can go down to Dungeons together, even if they significantly differ in levels. Secondly, they can give each other a hand in Astral quests. Thirdly, one may teleport to their best friend from farthermost edges of Sarnaut. And finally, best friends can lend each other most precious things: their mounts and astral ships. See, how deeply you should trust each other?

r526754.s: Brotherhood of the Last Shelter Guard

t: There are spiders prowling around in our garden, and the nasty creatures are huge... Someone should drive them away, or they will send Petrusha with a broom again.
I saw someone taking it to the south-east. The lead pioneer might know something.
h: Do you know where the blueish sphere is? The Dream Factory brought it with them and lost it here.

t: Alice? Of course, I know Alice. Who are you?
h: Greetings, pioneer. Do you know the girl named Alice?

t: Why do you ask? Are you snooping around? What are you, a spy? Or an astral pirate?
I'm a pioneer! And who are you? I don't think I saw you among the personnel of this camp, therefore you entered its territory without permission.

quests: May the Force Be With You

t:
You! Haha... I remember. Wings cut through the night, the fire burns... Those were the days!

But we are done! Can you hear me?! The fortress has fallen! The fortress, once white as the snow, now as dark as the night!

Four hours! Four hours!

Haha...
The stone... The stone floats... Thunder! The thunderstorm is coming! To arms!
Ah, it's you. We're chilling out here.

Alice? Of course, I know Alice. Why do you ask? We're good friends. She likes music, just like I do. Did you know that? We talk a lot about the latest trends in music. Like differences between the Arisen and Zem music. Which one do you like? I think it's time to throw them together. I want to get sheet music and play. Together with Alice, I think. Do you want to try? I need to ask Comrade Dynin if they have any amplifiers here. I think they have them. We can even set up a concert.

…

Are you even listening?
h: Do you know the girl named Alice?

t:
A chronophone... let me see... baritone, astralophone, marathon, megaphone, precious stone... no, I don't think so.

We talked about mana guitars. I showed her mine. It's good that we have a spare guitar in the music club. Alice doesn't have one. I hope Dynin will let her have it. Of course, sometimes he's a lot, but I hope he won't mind. Now we only need to chose the pieces. We could write songs on pieces of paper, throw them in a hat, mix them up, and pick one out randomly. So everyone will be happy. Now the Dune is so full of different races that it's super hard to find the right music. Everyone has a unique taste. You, for example. What do you like?

…

Are you even listening?
h: Ugh! Listen, did she mention a chronophone? It's a musical device. Kind of.

t:
That's right. You're a great observer. I was a singer in my past life. You know, among all this sand and pyramids, somebody's got to sing, right? My mates were silent even during their lifetime. I can't tell you how bad it got after death. So grim, it could make your hair stand on end. I like to chat, talk about things, discuss them! I feel very good around Alice. She's a listener. I told her a lot, like I have this project: I want to open a bard school on New Hickut. Which is, in fact, the old Xadagan, but now there's nothing left of it anyway. They dug it down. There are pyramids like you haven't seen before, not even in the Holy Land. It's so beautiful, even though it's so high. You can look down on everyone from up there. It's amazing...

…

Are you even listening?
h: You're an unusual Arisen for sure.

t:
I'm a leader of a music club. We need to organize a concert. We have so many talents among us, including hidden. I think it's very important that we reach general agreement, but how else can we achieve it, if not by common cause? Of all things, music is the best.

Rumor has it, there was such concert already. But we aren't any worse, we can do it too.

I'm Sarang Mika! An Arisen from Xadagan. I like music, fun, entertainment. That's my main difference from other Arisens. Do you have any idea how hard it is for me to be with the quiet, dark people you can't even talk to? This wonderful camp was a lucky place for me. It's much more fun and much more talkative people.
A thousand of astral imps! What is this? For hundreds of years I was tied to my ship, and now my feet tread on solid ground!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Hmm... You're a native, I suppose? That's interesting.

Aha, you're not a native after all! I felt it. The way you look discords somewhat with the surroundings, which can't be said of a creature that is used to the environment... Never mind, though. I'll be back soon. As soon as I'm through studying the local flora, which is pretty interesting.
h: Send the Arisen to the camp

t: A bargain is a bargain. We have plenty of land, and the men live well, thank Tensess. The old man worked in the field. It was a good life...
An' I'm telling them: what if it goes boom?
Oh, look at them rebelling against our glorious empress! They put up posters, they paint on the walls... Well, posters are okay - we use them for wiping, but the walls...!

What's that? An amulet that protects me from fear? Thank you, but I'm afraid it won't work for me. I don't believe in such things. Once I drank a bravery potion that an alchemist brewed for me and I fainted right away from fear of terrible side effects...
Make sure you don't lose it again!

r154725.s: Chief Hunter of the Old Tribe

t:
I'm aware. Do you think I'm blind and stupid?

All her plans are obvious to me. Oh, these goddesses of nature... And some consider them "good", even though their flowers are poisonous. Our "evil" is more honest.

Where did that monk of yours go? Did you find what you were looking for?
h: Alice decided to start a revolution!

t: A hundred rabbits will never make a horse, a hundred suspicions will never make a proof.
Hello there! How can I help you?
Hello there! How can I help you?
Hello there! How can I help you?
Hello there! How can I help you?
Hello there! How can I help you?
Hello there! How can I help you?
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?
They are confusing my last name. Either Ivanov, then Vasiliev or Andreev...

Allow me to introduce myself: postal official Lulukov, placed here by the will of the empress so that all local residents can communicate with each other. If you find my services satisfactory, perhaps you could bestow your patronage.

From our governor here. There has never been such a governor, your WorshipWorship. No words can describe the injuries he inflicts upon us. He has taken the bread out of our mouths by quartering soldiers on us, so that you might as well put your neck in a noose. He doesn't treat you as you deserve. Upon my word, if we had shown him any disrespect... but we obey all the laws and regulations. We don't mind giving him what his wife and daughter need for their clothes. But no, that's not enough. He comes to our shop and takes whatever his eyes fall on. Bribetaker!
Excellent! Bring it on! Everybody's dancing, you and me!

Greetings, Keeper. You should have noticed that you allod acquired a few more new rooms... of a specific purpose.

In case you need a place to lock up your enemies.
The world of fantasies is waiting for you! Are you ready?
Forget about the real world! Welcome to the Fantasy!
Are you ready to travel to the fantasy world?
What are we waiting for? Let's go!
Fantasy world is waiting for you, friend!

Well? How is it going? Long time no see, heh...

As you can see, we have a Club meeting. We decide what to do next. Now is our time, the time of the Free Traders! Why do you think?

Yes, it's as plain as a pike staff! Since they clashed in the Holy Land, the League and the Empire have been losing, and we have been gaining. Still, this is a matter of common interest. Which is what? We need our business to be good.

I provide transportation and make sure goods are delivered intact. And apparently we can ship goods to other worlds now. There's room for growth, heh.
Hey, what's up, rookie? Having fun, I hope? Come on, don't be sad!
Oh... This one got me bad. Looks like I'm going to the Purgatory once again...

You mission is pretty simple. See that bunch of imbeciles and a tadpole? The imbeciles are carrying the explosives, the tadpole will help them blow it up, and I am their commander. The are absolutely worthless on their own...
Pyk don't catch such prey. Pyk catch beasts, tunga-too!

Pyk remember, you came with furry two-hand two-leg beast! Pyk will catch it easy! Mrr... Murk was it name! Funny.

Pyk respect your hunt. You kill not to kill. Pyk kill to eat! Pyk eat, tunga-ha eat! Booka-Booka chief, hulu-tarsh, now forget my hunt and want to kill me! Pyk don't want! Pyk will help you.
And he says they've now brought fresh salmon to the tavern, so we'll have a snack...
It's in my stomach... I haven't eaten anything since the morning, so I have stomach cramps...
I am outraged by your insinuations! Yes, I know Mr. Raskolnikov, but we have never quarreled! And I had no idea this floozy knew him! As for the rest, I'm not telling you anything. Try and prove it!
h: What are you playing at? Tell me what happened...

t: Go ahead. You can't prove anything!
h: I'm ready to prove that you're lying!

t: Go ahead. You can't prove anything! You can't fool me!
h: I'm ready to prove that you're lying!

t: Hah, and what does that prove? That Amalia is telling the truth, and Raskolnikov is lying!
h: You didn't propose to Raskolnikov's sister.

t: Well, let's see... Then it means Amalia is lying, and Raskolnikov is telling the truth! And then what?

So you believe I'm lying but Sonya is telling the truth? If so, it means that I really did quarrel with Raskolnikov and knew that he was friends with Sonya, and so you believe I had a motive to take revenge on him... Which means Ekaterina is lying, and Raskolnikov is telling the truth. And so Amalia is also lying, and Lebezin is telling the truth, therefore he indeed saw that I planted the money! Yes, the evidence is clear! Bastards!!!
I'm Pyotr Luzhin, and I happen to live in this dreary place. I'm a lawyer.
Sonya didn't take his money, I'm telling you! She didn't even take 10 rubles! And she doesn't know this Raskolnikov!
Husband is a drunkard, stepdaughter is a hustler... I'm a poor woman with no means of support...

I know what happened – and despite the fact that we are friends with Pyotr Luzhin, I will tell you everything! This morning Luzhin went to the bank and withdrew 100 rubles. He divided them into two parts – 10 and 90. I saw it with my own eyes - he slipped these 90 to this unfortunate girl, Sonya!
h: What do you think about this situation with Luzhin and Marmeladova?

t: I'm an old acquaintance and neighbor of Pyotr Luzhin! What he did is a complete disgrace!
I wish to serve my country; youth could be no hindrance to loyalty!
Eidos was once crushed by Nihaz's rebellion. But I'll give my sister a dose of her own medicine - her kingdom will not withstand the wrath of the Awakened.

A small revolution will strip away my sister's power... Or not. In any case, it will reveal her true face. She pretends to be kind, resurrecting everyone, restoring Sarnaut... Once she has to destroy the awakened, no one will believe in her good intentions anymore!
h: What are you and the nihilists planning?

t: Yes, you have to make a choice... Decide which of us is right...
h: So we need to choose a side?

t: I am Zaretsky! Once a jolly rowdy, a gambler who won all the stakes, a tavern tribune, chief of rakes. But now a kind and simple father, albeit still a bachelor, a good landed proprietor, a friend in need, as you will gather.

Good day! I'm Rada Lemesheva, the master disassembler.

Times are tough and we can't just go out and buy fabric whenever we feel like it! There's a war raging - we need to be thrifty! That's why we disassemble items so that others can turn them into new items.
Hush! Hear that noise? Those are demons in the cargo hold, and they’re coming!
Ran Korr respect the strong! We shall meet again!
Zvik, zvik! I will happily help! Those baby Gibberlings are so cute!
Zvik, zvik! I'm glad you are here! Get on!

Zvik, zvik! It's good that you're here! Your friends are already in Skalgard! And I came back for you... I'm glad the raven saw you!

Let's hurry... in the city... there are some problems.

Get on!

Zvik, zvik! Do you always sail on these big boxes made of wood and iron? Hilarious!

And I bring good news: more and more First Ones are waking up from sleep! Even the spirits of Howlem, but they are still too weak to make the journey... The Great Ash is recovering; the Trees on the Kanian Archipelago, Frozen Frontier, Igsh, and Yakhch have sprouted new shoots!

Shadow woods are still there... But they stopped spreading! Zvik, zvik!
Hey, you're not one of my soldiers. Did you come with the reinforcements?

They destroyed the ships in the first place. See those wrecks on the shore? This is all that's left from the fleet. There is no Portal here, so we will have to fight our way out.

Oh wait! They've been repairing "Robust" on the other side of the allod! This is our chance!

Great warriors, huh? It's easy to be great if you're not afraid of dying! No blade or claw can put an end to your life as long as you believe in the Light. This must be very convenient? But does this make you great warriors? I don't think so. You want to prove yourselves? Alright then. I will teach you a couple of tricks with one condition: you will not use your gift of resurrection. Kill all the enemies on this island without dying, and then I will share my skills.

Oh... Do you even know how to hold a sword?
I thought so. You ain’t got the guts.

You want to know where they're holding Andrey Molotov? I guess I owe you my life, so I'll tell you. Andrey is on an Astral ship in Grave Harbor. The ship is called Valir, it's the only one there so you won't miss it. The captain of the ship is Nestor Kryukov and he has been ordered to take the prisoner off this allod in the event of an uprising. Molotov is held under lock and key and Kryukov keeps the key in his pocket at all times. Okay, is that good enough? It's time for me to disappear. Screw this mutiny, I've had enough!
Ugh, it's so hot here... How do they live like this? Well, at least I left some of my clothes in the camp...

I wouldn't even call that a task. Just digging around in the desert...

And besides, you'll be doing all the heroics, hah! I’m so tired of this training...
Really... Who would challenge us here? I'd welcome an opportunity to stretch my psionic muscles, heh.
h: It's time to escort the caravan!

t: Phew, that's good, because I'm sweating buckets... But I can still handle a magic monster or two - I'm not that Great a Mage yet to delegate everything, he he.
h: It seems to be one of our last tasks...

t:
I understand that it's difficult for you to fight against your own tribesmen. I believe many of them are misguided, not malicious.

I think over time our worlds will find a common ground. Both Waterlily and I would love to visit Sarnaut.
h: What do you think about the situation?

t: I'm the guy with the spear! I don't need flights or magic!
Alright. The old tribe knows no pain, but they die just like us.
I'm glad the All-Mother trusts you now.
Greetings from the House de Ardeur!

Of course, I knew everyone would compare the Galleon Castle and the Eclipse, ...

But how can you compare the incomparable? A workhorse and a doe?

You know, I'm starting to wonder if our architects overlooked something. Even Gorluxor equipped his version of the Castle with death rays. Weapons are a necessity in our world. The Eclipse has them, but it's getting more and more difficult to live aboard it... If we create something for the next Great Ball, it should be something truly destructive that can't be defended against.

But for now, let's just celebrate the Anniversary. There's still time!

r483384.s: Priestesse of the Church of Light

t: We’re probably out of our minds for deciding to come here. You can trust my gut, something ugly is waiting for us in that Citadel.
h: What do you think of the coming assault?

t: The fact that you're a ghost has its pluses.

Huh, I had a feeling in this damned Citadel that something was going wrong! I just sensed a trap, but Klavdia was so sure... Many people think she somehow deceived you, but speaking as a true traitor - she was simply deluded. Should the gods be any different from humans in this regard?

As for Hirkalla, we'll see. She wants us to serve her, just like we served Dakkar, but I want to understand what she really wants. And in order to find out, I need to get closer to her...

Greetings! What, you're here again? Looking for a new outfit or gossip?

Okay, I know you want to hear what's going on... Before this news spread around the world, I'll tell you: the power of our sovereign has noticeably weakened... No, the machine is still working, the Awakened are still being resurrected, but we no longer have control over the undead army.

There are still a few camps in the north, but in the south, near the Sadrok Palace, some scoundrel with a group of bandits managed to snatch them away! All sorts of dangerous creatures serve him... I also heard he has business in Dar Ulgorn and that he's looking for someone!
"Undress Reniesta." What kind of stupid advice is that?!  If the Gibberlings are right and I was destined to betray my friends, then the fight must be fair.
Banshee and I are ready when you need us.
Hiccup. I drink because I seek compassion... Not joy, but sorrow... I drink because I want to suffer!

Pyotr Luzhin is an honest and responsible man! A real lawyer! Don't listen to them - Mr. Luzhin never had that kind of money - 100 rubles! And he had no care for Raskolnikov's sister! He was going to marry me!
h: What do you think about Luzhin's accusation?

t: Good day! Amalia de Luner at your service. I am just a modest owner of apartments that I rent to all these unconscientious tenants!

quests: Problems of the City: Respected Man

t: The Darkness is lying that death can be escaped. You will prove it...

[Rhubarb murmurs thoughtfully]

I was just a snail crawling along the edge of a blade, a sharp blade. It was my dream. This is my nightmare. I crawl, I crawl, and I stay alive.

…

[Rhubarb seems to wake up. He glares at you]

We trusted you and you repaid us with betrayal!

quests: Making Friends with Grass and Trees
You will become one of them
Making Friends with Grass and Trees
Battle for Ambrosia: Extermination of Outlanders

t: Well, if you've earned the All-Mother's trust, alien, then I'll trust you, too.

Where else would they be? These fools have gone where they shouldn't... Like everything in our world, they will now facilitate the birth of a new life. The dead gives rise to the living - such is the eternal cycle.
h: Why are the corpses of the Expedition members here?

t: And then we thought of something: we want to borrow a ship from this sorceress and visit a certain place... Just don’t tell her!

The weather is bad today...

They say you're an Orc! But the Elder said we shouldn't be afraid of you.We didn’t believe it when they caught you. "What kind of Urun is this! And a black one to boot!"We've never caught anyone like you before!We've never caught anyone like you before!We've never caught anyone like you before!We've never caught anyone like you before!We've never caught anyone like you before!I thought you were from Skalgard, but then I saw that you're not from Skalgard.

Ooh, that's good... My vision was getting blurry already!

I was looking for a metal shaped like a number eight and, imagine that, I found it... But then one of the guys told me I wasn't strong enough to throw it aboard the ship. I don't know if I hit the target or not, but I lost it after I threw it... It's either somewhere under the ship, or aboard it...
h: Hello! I was sent to track you down and find the right part ...

t:
What?! How did you get that? I personally promised my girlfriend that I would kill Klakan and bring his head to her! Now what am I supposed to do since he's already dead?
Argh! All evil comes from women! I've been slacking on my training because of this stupid mission, and I'm sure she won't even appreciate my efforts! I need to give up this foolish stuff and concentrate on war and Goblinball!

Hello! Beliana Zharova, robot service department manager here.

Fixing things is my domain. We didn't take goblins with us, so it's all on different engineering bots.

I can get you one if you like. Here, meet Screwy. He's super independent. He leveled up his heuristic algorithm on his own.

He's not free as you understand. You have to pay with Dendrite Coins. Everyone loves Coins, am I right?
People won't change, and no one can make them, it's not worth the effort!

Yes, friends... I continue to atone for my sins... And by the gracious permission of Porfiry, I can leave Jigran and visit such places where I listen to wise people and, as someone who encountered Aisa, offer some advice...

quests: Problems of the City: Distorted Ghouls

t:
Hey, I'm test-driving cars here, can't you see?

There's a lot of stuff piled up around here, you can put anything together, but first you need to figure out what's what! Get it?

I test drive vehicles, but nothing ever works as it should. Things keep breaking, because everything is jumbled up together. There's no order!
Ugh, why do they keep breaking...
My dream has finally come true!

I’m the chief architect. Many members of our House worked on the Castle. It’s an incredible creation that can exist autonomously for years in the depths of the Astral...

Of course, what happened to the first Castle was unfortunate... Despite that blow, we found strength to build another one. We gave it a few upgrades but followed the old project plans for the most part.
h: So you are the creator of Galleon Castle?

t:
Please call her Celestine... Nihil is a terrifying creature in Tep’s service, but the Celestine I knew was a clever, kind, and charming girl who at times became overly engrossed in her ideas that went beyond what we’re used to...

To honor Celestine, we named the AI of the ship after her. I hope I managed to transfer some of her traits to it. Let her live on in this form.
h: As far as I know, Nihil created the artificial intelligence for the previous Galleon Castle.

t:
I can't believe my eyes! People! Real people!
No matter who you are, just help me, please! Someone else should have survived!
Thank you! I am no warrior, so I'll step aside.

Normally you can come across nobody but Demons in the Astral, but some time ago huge swarms of termites came from nowhere, invulnerable to the Astral or anything else. At first they attacked ships, and once they even made it to Nezebgrad! One of the Free Traders entrapped a few, dissected their bodies and found meteorite dust inside.
The smell of money made us sign on to find their nest. Off we went, and were unlucky enough to find it - as soon as we approached, a whole lot of them attacked us. The last thing I remember was a heavy blow on the head.
When I came round, there was no one around. All my crew were carried away by the termites. Even my little sister... oh, she wanted to see the Astral so, she begged to take her with me...
They say insects don't devour their prey right away. May be there still is a chance to save them... Please, help!

quests: If You Feel Like Riding, Go Get Some Lianas
Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the elves of House de Tristesse

t: Agrh! Cursed humans! It's the moon, it's just the moon... Its brilliance penetrates the darkness of the night, its call.... drives you crazy... Ooh!

h: Do you have something for me?

t:
Oh, I'm glad to hear that. Our field is very important...

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Natural sciences! I guess you're an expert in those already. You've collected so many different samples of minerals, gutted so many animals, and studied loads of... excrements of modified tigers.

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it.
The world around us will bring us many new discoveries, we just need to keep moving forward.

I hate the likes of you! Normal people’s hobby is gold, food and wine! And there are those with the Mission! Considering themselves saints! Oh well, all right, I will tell you about the girl.

As to you, Silberpod, you wanted my treasure? Take it, choke on it! You killed Benny - now you’re taking his place! You’ll be guarding this treasure till the end of the days!

This portal led to Umoir long ago. We used to do some illegal trade, have our share, you know, before the Queen found out. She locked the portal then, and however hard we tried to open it, we failed. Your friend must be pretty powerful - she clicked her fingers and passed, that’s that. So she’s nowhere else, but in Umoir now. Want to catch up with her? Touch the four June pillars here and go, don’t let the door hit your... rear.
So, you’ve found my treasures, eh? What are you waiting for? Take them! Aren’t you rich now?

quests: Take part in the athletic competition, pass all checkpoints and reach…

t: Hello there! How can I help you?
